definition: Close a grid cycle unconditionally once it has been open longer than a set time, whatever its result.
boundaries: Known failure it answers: an old grid cycle carries far more risk than a young one with the same equity curve, and grids show steady gains, then one loss that takes it all. Named so a unit, a source or he can point at it; its maths is the risk session's.
recognition: A grid that has run too long is shut down, win or lose.

sources.quote: fires unconditionally when the cycle exceeds InpMaxCycleHours (default: 72 hours)
then a catastrophic loss that wipes everything in days
